title: Puka Nacua's lawyer blasts accuser, says biting was 'minor incident' | Exclusive

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Puka Nacua's lawyer blasts accuser, says biting was 'minor incident' | Exclusive
sources.description: An attorney for Rams WR Puka Nacua says a biting incident that left him facing civil lawsuit is “a minor incident" being used for a "payday."
